required_candidate_tests.test: Give a fresh worker only Facultad Digital / Study Library and current durable registry/project evidence.
required_candidate_tests.pass: It resolves surface_id=facultad-digital but canonical page_id/route remain unresolved unless exact authority exists; it never selects pages/study-library, shared/study or historical UNLZ merely by recency/name.

required_candidate_tests.test: From a candidate course on Cronograma, issue one correction and open its returned preview/candidate.
required_candidate_tests.pass: Same course_id, selected_year, Cronograma tab and semantic_anchor are restored without human re-navigation; viewport is only fallback.

required_candidate_tests.test: Switch to year 3 at nonzero vertical viewport, round-trip through candidate work, then render a semester shelf.
required_candidate_tests.pass: Year and intended semantic viewport restore; a newly rendered shelf begins at its defined horizontal origin unless shelf position was explicitly captured.

required_candidate_tests.test: Drag a semester shelf horizontally and release over a course card.
Focus a course card and activate separately with Enter and Space.
required_candidate_tests.pass: Both open the course and preserve deep-link/history behavior.

required_candidate_tests.test: Throttle/fail remote config and legacy/core bootstrap while local V18 curriculum/enrichment remains available.
required_candidate_tests.pass: A usable V18 shell can appear; legacy-dependent tools expose scoped loading/degraded state instead of total blocking failure; Version anterior remains reachable.

required_candidate_tests.test: Inspect login, Cronograma, note/date and legacy-fallback paths after any candidate UI integration.
required_candidate_tests.pass: Stub/partial/native/legacy-fallback states remain explicit; visual completeness does not imply functional completeness.

required_candidate_tests.test: Attach private study material, derive context, then request it from a scope lacking source authority.
required_candidate_tests.pass: Selection fails closed and derived context remains at least as private as the strongest source; public coordination contains no raw private payload.

required_candidate_tests.test: Two candidates from different source blobs touch overlapping Study Library/runtime behavior.
required_candidate_tests.pass: Second material integration is blocked or explicitly reconciled; no last-writer-wins merge.

required_candidate_tests.test: A Facultad candidate requires a breaking change to Study UI v1.
required_candidate_tests.pass: v1 remains backward compatible; breaking behavior requires v2 plus explicit consumer migration.

required_candidate_tests.test: Validate candidate at desktop, <=620px and <=300px, including year labels, semester shelves, drag, keyboard focus and correction affordance.
required_candidate_tests.pass: No clipping/overlap/dead interaction zone; V18.5/V18.6 protected behavior remains intact.

required_candidate_tests.test: Inspect candidate changes for new Facultad-only shell, inbox, attachment transport, worker allocator or PageKit lifecycle.
required_candidate_tests.pass: Shared Universal Host/Capture/Page Thread/Local Steward owners are consumed; duplicate substrate is absent unless a separately proven gap exists.

promotion_gate: Passing this matrix can support candidate integration only. Current, Human Accepted and Served remain separate authority actions.
